title: Shooter: USS Nimitz Catapult Officers
description: A feature produced for the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz (CVN 68) monthly newscast, Nimitz On Air, centered on the operational role of the “Shooters,” or catapult officers who launch aircraft from the ship. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Carson Croom)
